items.part_zh: CONSORT 对照检查清单与非药物临床试验扩展版

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准

items.content_zh: 针刺治疗的类型，如中医针刺、日本汉方医学针刺、韩医针刺、西医针刺、五行针、耳针等。
items.content_en: Style of acupuncture, e.g. Traditional Chinese Medicine, Japanese, Korean, Western medical, Five Element, ear acupuncture, etc.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 所提供针刺治疗的理由、依据的历史背景、文献来源和/或形成共识的方法；适当处引用文献。
items.content_en: Reasoning for treatment provided, based on historical context, literature sources, and/or consensus methods, with references where appropriate.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 说明对何种治疗作了变动。
items.content_en: Extent to which treatment was varied.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 每一受试对象每个治疗单元用针的数目；如可能，用均数和范围表示。
items.content_en: Number of needle insertions per subject per session, mean and range where relevant.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 使用的穴位名称，注明单侧/双侧；如无标准名称，则说明位置。
items.content_en: Names, or location if no standard name, of points used, including unilateral or bilateral use.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 进针深度，采用指定计量单位或特定组织层面描述。
items.content_en: Depth of insertion, based on a specified unit of measurement or on a particular tissue level.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 引发的机体反应，如得气或肌肉抽动反应。
items.content_en: Response sought, e.g. de qi or muscle twitch response.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 针刺刺激方式，如手针刺激或电针刺激。
items.content_en: Needle stimulation, e.g. manual or electrical.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 留针时间。
items.content_en: Needle retention time.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 针具类型，包括直径、长度、生产厂家或材质。
items.content_en: Needle type, including diameter, length, and manufacturer or material.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 治疗单元数。
items.content_en: Number of treatment sessions.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 治疗单元的频数和持续时间。
items.content_en: Frequency and duration of treatment sessions.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 对针刺组施加的其他干预措施细节，如艾灸、拔罐、中药、锻炼、生活方式建议。
items.content_en: Details of other interventions administered to the acupuncture group, e.g. moxibustion, cupping, herbs, exercises, lifestyle advice.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 治疗场所和相关信息，包括对治疗师的操作指导，以及给患者的信息和解释。
items.content_en: Setting and context of treatment, including instructions to practitioners, and information and explanations to patients.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 对参与研究的针灸师的描述，包括资质或从业部门、从事针刺实践的年数、其他相关经历。
items.content_en: Description of participating acupuncturists, including qualification or professional affiliation, years in acupuncture practice, and other relevant experience.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 在研究问题阐述中援引资料说明选择对照或对照措施的合理性。
items.content_en: Rationale for the control or comparator in the context of the research question, with sources that justify this choice.

items.part_zh: 表3 针刺临床试验干预措施报告标准
items.part_en: Table 3 STRICTA 2010 Checklist for Acupuncture Trials
items.content_zh: 精确描述对照或对照措施；如果采用假针刺或其他类似针刺的对照措施，则提供条目1到条目3所要求的详细信息。
items.content_en: Precise description of the control or comparator. If sham acupuncture or any other type of acupuncture-like control is used, provide details as for Items 1 to 3 above.

items.domain_zh: 行政信息：题目和结构式摘要
items.domain_en: Administrative information: Title and structured summary
items.content_zh: 题目应说明试验设计、研究人群和干预措施，并明确识别为试验方案。
items.content_en: Title stating the trial design, population, and interventions, with identification as a protocol.

items.domain_zh: 行政信息：题目和结构式摘要
items.domain_en: Administrative information: Title and structured summary
items.content_zh: 结构式摘要应概述试验设计和方法，并包括世界卫生组织试验注册数据集中的相关项目。
items.content_en: Structured summary of trial design and methods, including items from the World Health Organization Trial Registration Data Set.

items.content_zh: 方案版本日期和版本标识。
items.content_en: Version date and identifier.

items.content_zh: 方案贡献者的姓名、单位和角色。
items.content_en: Names, affiliations, and roles of protocol contributors.

items.content_zh: 试验申办方的名称和联系方式。
items.content_en: Name and contact information for the trial sponsor.

items.content_zh: 试验申办方和资助方在试验设计、实施、分析和报告中的作用，包括其对这些活动是否具有决策权。
items.content_en: Role of trial sponsor and funders in design, conduct, analysis, and reporting of trial; including any authority over these activities.

items.content_zh: 如适用，说明协调中心、指导委员会、终点评定委员会、数据管理团队以及其他监督试验的个人或组织的组成、角色和职责。
items.content_en: Composition, roles, and responsibilities of the coordinating site, steering committee, endpoint adjudication committee, data management team, and other individuals or groups overseeing the trial, if applicable.

items.content_zh: 试验注册机构名称、注册编号及网址，以及注册日期。如尚未注册，应说明拟注册机构。
items.content_en: Name of trial registry, identifying number (with URL), and date of registration. If not yet registered, name of intended registry.

items.content_zh: 说明试验方案和统计分析计划可从何处获取。
items.content_en: Where the trial protocol and statistical analysis plan can be accessed.

items.content_zh: 说明去标识化个体参与者数据，包括数据字典、统计代码和其他相关材料，将在何处以及如何获取。
items.content_en: Where and how the individual de-identified participant data, including data dictionary, statistical code, and any other materials will be accessible.

items.content_zh: 资助和其他支持来源，例如药物或设备供应。
items.content_en: Sources of funding and other support, e.g., supply of drugs.

items.content_zh: 主要研究者和指导委员会成员的经济性和其他利益冲突。
items.content_en: Financial and other conflicts of interest for principal investigators and steering committee members.

items.content_zh: 说明向受试者、医务人员、公众和其他相关群体传播试验结果的计划，例如在注册平台报告、撰写通俗摘要或发表论文。
items.content_en: Plans to communicate trial results to participants, healthcare professionals, the public, and other relevant groups, e.g., reporting in trial registry, plain language summary, publication.

items.content_zh: 科学背景和研究依据，包括与各干预措施获益和危害相关的已发表及未发表研究总结。
items.content_en: Scientific background and rationale, including summary of relevant studies, published and unpublished, examining benefits and harms for each intervention.

items.content_zh: 说明选择对照措施的理由。
items.content_en: Explanation for choice of comparator.

items.content_zh: 与获益和危害相关的具体研究目的。
items.content_en: Specific objectives related to benefits and harms.

items.content_zh: 患者或公众参与试验设计、实施和报告的具体情况或计划。
items.content_en: Details of, or plans for, patient or public involvement in the design, conduct, and reporting of the trial.

items.content_zh: 描述试验设计，包括试验类型，例如平行分组或交叉设计；分配比例；以及研究框架，例如优效性、等效性、非劣效性或探索性。
items.content_en: Description of trial design including type of trial, e.g., parallel group, crossover, allocation ratio, and framework, e.g., superiority, equivalence, non-inferiority, exploratory.

items.content_zh: 说明试验实施场所，例如社区或医院，以及实施地点，例如国家、地区或研究中心。
items.content_en: Settings, e.g., community, hospital, and locations, e.g., countries, sites, where the trial will be conducted.

items.content_zh: 受试者合格标准。
items.content_en: Eligibility criteria for participants.

items.content_zh: 如适用，说明研究中心和实施干预者的合格标准。
items.content_en: If applicable, eligibility criteria for sites and for individuals who will deliver the interventions, e.g., surgeons, physiotherapists.

items.content_zh: 充分描述干预和对照措施，使他人能够重复，包括如何实施、何时实施以及由谁实施。如相关，应说明干预和对照措施的额外材料，例如操作手册，可从何处获取。
items.content_en: Intervention and comparator with sufficient details to allow replication including how, when, and by whom they will be administered. If relevant, where additional materials describing the intervention and comparator, e.g., intervention manual, can be accessed.

items.content_zh: 说明停止或调整已分配干预/对照措施的标准，例如因危害事件、受试者要求或疾病改善/恶化而调整。
items.content_en: Criteria for discontinuing or modifying allocated intervention/comparator for a trial participant, e.g., drug dose change in response to harms, participant request, or improving/worsening disease.

items.content_zh: 如适用，说明提高干预/对照方案依从性的策略，以及监测依从性的程序，例如药片回收或治疗次数记录。
items.content_en: Strategies to improve adherence to intervention/comparator protocols, if applicable, and any procedures for monitoring adherence, e.g., drug tablet return, sessions attended.

items.content_zh: 说明试验期间允许或禁止的合并治疗。
items.content_en: Concomitant care that is permitted or prohibited during the trial.

items.content_zh: 说明主要和次要结局，包括每项结局的具体测量变量、分析指标、汇总方法和评估时间点。
items.content_en: Primary and secondary outcomes, including the specific measurement variable, e.g., systolic blood pressure, analysis metric, e.g., change from baseline, final value, time to event, method of aggregation, e.g., median, proportion, and time point for each outcome.

items.content_zh: 说明危害如何定义以及如何评价，例如系统性评价或非系统性评价。
items.content_en: How harms are defined and will be assessed, e.g., systematically, non-systematically.

items.content_zh: 说明受试者入组、干预、评估和访视的时间安排，包括任何导入期和洗脱期。强烈建议提供示意图。
items.content_en: Time schedule of enrollment, interventions, including any run-ins and washouts, assessments, and visits for participants. A schematic diagram is highly recommended.

items.content_zh: 说明样本量如何确定，包括支持样本量计算的所有假设。
items.content_en: How sample size was determined, including all assumptions supporting the sample size calculation.

items.content_zh: 说明为达到目标样本量而采取的招募策略。
items.content_en: Strategies for achieving adequate participant enrollment to reach target sample size.

items.content_zh: 说明由谁生成随机分配序列，以及所用方法。
items.content_en: Who will generate the random allocation sequence and the method used.

items.content_zh: 说明随机化类型，例如简单随机或限制性随机，以及分层因素。为降低随机序列可预测性，区组等限制性随机化细节应放在单独文件中，且不向负责入组或分配干预的人员开放。
items.content_en: Type of randomization, simple or restricted, and details of any factors for stratification. To reduce predictability of a random sequence, other details of any planned restriction, e.g., blocking, should be provided in a separate document that is unavailable to those who enroll participants or assign interventions.

items.content_zh: 说明实施随机分配序列的机制，例如中央计算机/电话系统，或按顺序编号、不透明、密封容器；并描述在分配干预前隐藏序列的措施。
items.content_en: Mechanism used to implement the random allocation sequence, e.g., central computer/telephone; sequentially numbered, opaque, sealed containers, describing any steps to conceal the sequence until interventions are assigned.

items.content_zh: 说明负责入组和分配干预的人员是否能够接触随机分配序列。
items.content_en: Whether the personnel who will enroll and those who will assign participants to the interventions will have access to the random allocation sequence.

items.content_zh: 说明分配干预后哪些人员将被设盲，例如受试者、干预实施者、结局评价者和数据分析者。
items.content_en: Who will be blinded after assignment to interventions, e.g., participants, care providers, outcome assessors, data analysts.

items.content_zh: 如实施盲法，说明如何实现盲法，并描述干预措施的相似性。
items.content_en: If blinded, how blinding will be achieved and description of the similarity of interventions.

items.content_zh: 如实施盲法，说明允许揭盲的情形，以及试验期间揭示受试者分配干预的程序。
items.content_en: If blinded, circumstances under which unblinding is permissible, and procedure for revealing a participant’s allocated intervention during the trial.

items.content_zh: 说明试验数据评估和收集计划，包括促进数据质量的相关措施，例如重复测量和评价者培训；并描述试验工具，如问卷或实验室检测。如已知，应说明其信度和效度。如数据收集表未包含在方案中，应说明可从何处获取。
items.content_en: Plans for assessment and collection of trial data, including any related processes to promote data quality, e.g., duplicate measurements, training of assessors, and a description of trial instruments, e.g., questionnaires, laboratory tests, along with their reliability and validity, if known. Reference to where data collection forms can be accessed, if not in the protocol.

items.content_zh: 说明促进受试者留存和完整随访的计划，包括对停止干预或偏离干预方案的受试者仍需收集哪些结局数据。
items.content_en: Plans to promote participant retention and complete follow-up, including list of any outcome data to be collected for participants who discontinue or deviate from intervention protocols.

items.content_zh: 说明数据录入、编码、安全和存储计划，包括促进数据质量的相关措施，例如双人数据录入和数据范围核查。如数据管理程序细节未包含在方案中，应说明可从何处获取。
items.content_en: Plans for data entry, coding, security, and storage, including any related processes to promote data quality, e.g., double data entry; range checks for data values. Reference to where details of data management procedures can be accessed, if not in the protocol.

items.content_zh: 说明比较组间主要和次要结局，包括危害结局，所用的统计学方法。
items.content_en: Statistical methods used to compare groups for primary and secondary outcomes, including harms.

items.content_zh: 定义每项分析纳入哪些受试者，例如所有随机化受试者，以及其所属分析组。
items.content_en: Definition of who will be included in each analysis, e.g., all randomized participants, and in which group.

items.content_zh: 说明分析中如何处理缺失数据。
items.content_en: How missing data will be handled in the analysis.

items.content_zh: 说明其他分析方法，例如亚组分析和敏感性分析。
items.content_en: Methods for any additional analyses, e.g., subgroup and sensitivity analyses.

items.content_zh: 说明数据监测委员会的组成、角色和报告结构；说明其是否独立于申办方和资助方；说明利益冲突；并说明如方案中未包含委员会章程，相关详细信息可从何处获取。或者说明为什么不需要数据监测委员会。
items.content_en: Composition of data monitoring committee, DMC; summary of its role and reporting structure; statement of whether it is independent from the sponsor and funder; conflicts of interest and reference to where further details about its charter can be found, if not in the protocol. Alternatively, an explanation of why a DMC is not needed.

items.content_zh: 说明中期分析和停止试验原则，包括谁可以接触中期结果，以及谁最终决定终止试验。
items.content_en: Explanation of any interim analyses and stopping guidelines, including who will have access to these interim results and make the final decision to terminate the trial.

items.content_zh: 说明试验实施监查的频率和程序。如无监查，应说明理由。
items.content_en: Frequency and procedures for monitoring trial conduct. If there is no monitoring, give explanation.

items.content_zh: 说明申请研究伦理委员会/机构审查委员会批准的计划。
items.content_en: Plans for seeking research ethics committee/institutional review board approval.

items.content_zh: 说明向相关方沟通重要方案修改的计划。
items.content_en: Plans for communicating important protocol modifications to relevant parties.

items.content_zh: 说明由谁向潜在受试者或其授权代理人获取知情同意或同意，以及如何获取。
items.content_en: Who will obtain informed consent or assent from potential trial participants or authorized proxies, and how.

items.content_zh: 如适用，说明辅助研究中收集和使用受试者数据及生物样本的额外同意规定。
items.content_en: Additional consent provisions for collection and use of participant data and biological specimens in ancillary studies, if applicable.

items.content_zh: 说明如何收集、共享和保存潜在及已入组受试者的个人信息，以在试验前、试验中和试验后保护其隐私。
items.content_en: How personal information about potential and enrolled participants will be collected, shared, and maintained in order to protect confidentiality before, during, and after the trial.

items.content_zh: 如有，说明辅助照护和试验后照护安排，以及对因试验参与而受到伤害者的补偿规定。
items.content_en: Provisions, if any, for ancillary and post-trial care, and for compensation to those who suffer harm from trial participation.

items.content_zh: 说明研究对象属于：1）西医定义疾病；2）西医定义疾病合并特定中医证候；或3）中医证候。
items.content_en: Specify the patient population in terms of: 1) a Western medicine-defined disease; 2) a Western medicine-defined disease with a specific TCM pattern; or 3) a TCM pattern.

items.content_zh: 说明干预措施为针刺、电针或其他针刺相关中医治疗。
items.content_en: Specify the intervention in terms of acupuncture, electroacupuncture, or other acupuncture-related TCM therapy.

items.domain_zh: 背景和依据：中医理论背景
items.content_zh: 基于中医理论说明研究问题的背景和依据。
items.content_en: Provide the background and rationale of the research question with TCM theory.

items.domain_zh: 背景和依据：针刺干预依据
items.content_zh: 描述所采用针刺干预的理论依据，并提供参考文献。对于针刺，应说明治疗方案依据是否来源于历史背景、已有研究、专家共识或其他方法。
items.content_en: Describe the rationale of the utilized acupuncture intervention with references. For acupuncture, the description should include the rationale for treatment protocol, whether it is from historical context, available studies, and/or consensus methods. Corresponding references should also be provided.

items.domain_zh: 背景和依据：联合治疗依据
items.domain_en: Background and rationale: Additional TCM intervention
items.content_zh: 如果西医治疗作为基础治疗或联合治疗，应说明加入针刺干预的理由；如可能，应解释西医治疗与针刺干预之间的潜在相互作用。
items.content_en: Provide the rationale of adding experimental acupuncture intervention if Western medicine intervention is used as basic or combined remedy. If possible, the potential interaction between Western medicine intervention and acupuncture intervention should also be explained with related references.

items.domain_zh: 背景和依据：对照选择依据
items.domain_en: Background and rationale: Choice of comparator
items.content_zh: 说明选择对照措施的理由和原则，应考虑：1）是否可与试验针刺干预比较；2）是否有利于盲法成功。
items.content_en: Describe the rationale and principles for selecting comparators corresponding to acupuncture intervention, considering: 1) comparable with tested intervention; and 2) success of blinding.

items.content_zh: 说明针对特定针刺干预的研究目的或假设，并明确其针对：1）西医定义疾病；2）西医定义疾病合并特定中医证候；或3）中医证候。
items.content_en: State the objectives or hypotheses regarding the specific acupuncture intervention for: 1) a Western medicine-defined disease; 2) a Western medicine-defined disease with a specific TCM pattern; or 3) a TCM pattern.

items.content_zh: 说明是否招募特定中医证候受试者。如是，应报告：1）诊断标准；2）纳入和排除标准。所用标准应为公认标准，或提供可查询详细解释的参考文献。
items.content_en: State whether participants with a specific TCM pattern will be recruited, in terms of: 1) diagnostic criteria; and 2) inclusion and exclusion criteria. All criteria utilized should be universally recognized, or references where detailed explanations can be found should be given.

items.domain_zh: 合格标准：研究人员资质
items.content_zh: 建议描述中医研究相关人员的角色、资质和经验，例如受试者筛选者、针灸师、结局评价者、数据分析者。
items.content_en: Descriptions of the roles, qualifications and other relevant experience of the researchers, e.g., participant screeners, care providers, outcome assessors, data analysts, in TCM research are recommended.

items.domain_zh: 合格标准：研究中心资质
items.content_zh: 建议描述参与中医试验的研究中心资质和相关经验，尤其是多中心针刺试验。
items.content_en: Descriptions of the qualification and relevant experience of study center(s) involved in a TCM trial are recommended.

items.domain_zh: 针刺干预：治疗环境和体位
items.domain_en: Experimental intervention: Treatment environment and posture
items.content_zh: 报告治疗环境和受试者体位。
items.content_en: Treatment environment and participant posture.

items.content_zh: 报告每名受试者每次治疗的进针数量；如可能，用均数和范围表示。
items.content_en: Number of needle insertions per subject per session, mean and range if possible.

items.domain_zh: 针刺干预：穴位名称和定位
items.content_zh: 报告穴位名称和定位，注明单侧或双侧。所有穴位名称应同时用中文拼音和国际代码表示。
items.content_en: Names and location of acupoints, unilateral or bilateral. Name of all acupoints should be presented in Chinese Pinyin and international code.

items.domain_zh: 针刺干预：进针角度和深度
items.content_zh: 报告进针角度和进针深度，应使用明确计量单位或特定组织层面描述。
items.content_en: Angle and depth of insertion, which should be presented in a specified unit of measurement or on a particular tissue level.

items.domain_zh: 针刺干预：预期针刺反应
items.content_zh: 报告预期针刺反应，例如得气或肌肉抽动反应。
items.content_en: Response sought, e.g., de qi or muscle twitch response.

items.domain_zh: 针刺干预：针刺刺激方式
items.content_zh: 报告针刺刺激方式，例如手法刺激或电刺激。如使用电针仪，应说明品牌、生产厂家和频率。
items.content_en: Needle stimulation, e.g., manual, electrical. If electroacupuncture apparatus will be utilized, the brand, manufacturer and frequency should be indicated.

items.content_zh: 报告留针时间。
items.content_en: Needle retention time.

items.content_zh: 报告针具类型，包括直径、长度、生产厂家和材质等。
items.content_en: Needle type, including diameter, length, manufacturer and material, etc.

items.content_zh: 报告治疗次数。
items.content_en: Number of treatment sessions.

items.domain_zh: 针刺干预：治疗频率和持续时间
items.content_zh: 报告治疗频率和每次治疗持续时间。
items.content_en: Frequency and duration of treatment sessions.

items.domain_zh: 针刺对照：空白/等待名单对照
items.content_zh: 如采用空白或等待名单对照，应说明治疗前、治疗中和治疗后与试验干预相对应的特殊安排，例如治疗前检查、治疗期间生活方式和用药保持不变、治疗后补偿性干预。
items.content_en: For blank/waitlist control, state any special arrangements in pre-treatment, treatment and post-treatment periods corresponding to the experimental intervention, e.g., examinations in pre-treatment period, unaltered lifestyle and medication in treatment period, and compensatory interventions in post-treatment period.

items.domain_zh: 针刺对照：假针刺或类似针刺对照
items.domain_en: Control intervention: Sham acupuncture or acupuncture-like control
items.content_zh: 如采用假针刺或类似针刺对照，应说明其与真实针刺干预的可比性，并按照 11a.1B 的要求完整报告对照措施细节。
items.content_en: For sham acupuncture or acupuncture-like control, state the comparability of the sham acupuncture or acupuncture-like control and comprehensively provide details as for the recommendations of Intervention 11a.1B.

items.content_zh: 建议描述试验组和/或对照组将接受的其他干预，例如救援干预、常规治疗或合并治疗，并提供足够细节以便重复。
items.content_en: Descriptions of other interventions that will be administrated to experimental and/or control groups are recommended, e.g., rescue interventions, with enough details to allow replication.

items.domain_zh: 结局指标：中医相关结局依据
items.content_zh: 说明将中医相关指标作为结局的依据，例如与辨证相关的症状和体征程度及范围变化。
items.content_en: Provide the rationale of TCM-related indexes as outcomes, e.g., the change of degree and scope of symptoms and signs related to pattern differentiation.

items.domain_zh: 结局指标：中医相关结局评价
items.content_zh: 详细说明中医相关结局评价，包括：1）测量方法和标准，例如症状体征频率、严重程度评分、经过验证的证候问卷、评价时间点及其理由；2）评价者资质，例如相关评价经验、临床实践年限；3）提高评价质量的方法，例如重复观察、评价者培训；4）相关参考文献。
items.content_en: Provide the details of the TCM-related outcomes assessment, including: 1) the measuring methods and standard, e.g., frequency, severity rating scale of symptoms and signs, verified pattern questionnaire, time points for assessment and corresponding rationale; 2) assessor qualification, e.g., relevant assessment experience, years in clinical practice; 3) methods used to enhance the quality of assessment, e.g., multiple repeated observation, training of assessors; and 4) related references.

items.domain_zh: 数据收集方法：证候基线资料
items.domain_en: Data collection methods: TCM pattern baseline data
items.content_zh: 如果试验针对中医证候，或西医定义疾病合并特定中医证候，应提供中医证候相关基线资料。
items.content_en: When trial targeting TCM pattern, or a Western medicine-defined disease with a specific TCM pattern, baseline data about TCM pattern should be provided.

items.content_zh: 明确报告研究是系统评价、Meta分析，还是两者兼有；如果研究了具体的针刺类型，则应在题目中说明，如手法针刺或电针。
items.content_en: Identify the report as a systematic review, meta-analysis, or both; if applicable, state the specific type of acupuncture treatment, such as manual acupuncture or electroacupuncture.

items.content_zh: 提供结构式摘要，包括研究背景、目的、资料来源、纳入排除标准、研究对象/干预措施、研究评价和综合方法、结果、局限、结论和主要发现、系统评价注册号。
items.content_en: Provide a structured summary including, as applicable: background; objectives; data sources; study eligibility criteria, participants, and interventions; study appraisal and synthesis methods; results limitations; conclusions and implications of key findings; systematic review registration number.

items.content_zh: 在背景中描述已知的针刺干预对目标疾病或症状的作用原理；若适用，需具体到拟研究的特定针刺类型，并描述不同针刺类型之间的效果是否有差异。
items.content_en: Describe the rationale for what is already known about acupuncture for the target condition in the background; if applicable, state what is already known about the specific types of acupuncture to be studied, and describe whether there is any difference of the effects among different types of acupuncture.

items.content_zh: 基于研究对象、干预措施、对照措施、结局指标和研究类型，即 PICOS，提出清晰明确的研究问题。
items.content_en: Provide an explicit statement of questions being addressed with reference to participants, interventions, comparisons, outcomes, and study design, PICOS.

items.content_zh: 如果已有研究方案，则说明方案内容并给出可获得途径，如网址；并提供现有注册信息，包括注册号。
items.content_en: Indicate if a review protocol exists, if and where it can be accessed, e.g. web address, and, if available, provide registration information including registration number.

items.content_zh: 说明作为纳入排除标准的研究特征，如 PICOS 和随访时间，以及报告特征，如发表年份、语言和发表状态，并给出理由。
items.content_en: Specify study characteristics, e.g. PICOS and length of follow-up, and report characteristics, e.g. years considered, language and publication status, used as criteria for eligibility, giving rationale.

items.content_zh: 描述目标疾病的西医诊断标准。
items.content_en: Describe the diagnostic criteria of the target condition in Western medicine.

items.content_zh: 如果适用，描述目标疾病在传统医学中的诊断标准，例如中医诊断标准。
items.content_en: If applicable, describe the diagnostic criteria in terms of Traditional Medicine, such as Traditional Chinese Medicine.

items.content_zh: 描述拟纳入的具体针刺类型，如手法针刺、电针或火针等。
items.content_en: Describe the types of acupuncture to be included, such as traditional acupuncture, electroacupuncture, or fire acupuncture.

items.content_zh: 如果适用，描述拟关注结局指标在传统医学中，如症状缓解得分，或西医中，如疼痛强度量表、VAS量表，的评估或分类标准或工具。
items.content_en: If applicable, report measures for therapeutic effects using the terminology of either traditional medicine, e.g. syndrome score for syndrome remission, or Western medicine, e.g. pain intensity.

items.content_zh: 描述检索的所有信息来源，例如数据库、检索时间范围、是否联系研究作者确定是否存在更多相关研究，并报告最后检索日期；如适用，报告针刺或传统医学相关数据库或补充检索方法。
items.content_en: Describe all sources of information, e.g. databases with dates of coverage and contact with study authors to identify additional studies, in the search, and report the date of the last search. If applicable, report the databases or complementary search methods for acupuncture or traditional medicine.

items.content_zh: 提供至少一个常用数据库，如 MEDLINE，的完整检索策略，包括所有限定条件，以保证检索方法可重复；如同时检索综合数据库和传统医学数据库，则至少提供一个综合数据库和一个传统医学数据库的完整检索策略。
items.content_en: Present full electronic search strategy for at least one commonly used database, e.g. MEDLINE, including any limits used, such that it could be repeated. If applicable, include the full search strategy for at least a Western and a traditional medicine database for each systematic review where both were used.

items.content_zh: 说明纳入研究的筛选过程，包括初筛、合格性判断及纳入系统评价等步骤；如适用，还包括纳入 Meta 分析的过程。
items.content_en: State the process for selecting studies, including screening, eligibility, included in systematic review, and, if applicable, included in the meta-analysis.

items.content_zh: 描述资料提取方法，如设计提取表格、独立提取、重复提取，以及向纳入研究作者获取或确认资料和数据的过程。
items.content_en: Describe method of data extraction from reports, e.g. piloted forms, independently, in duplicate, and any processes for obtaining and confirming data from investigators.

items.content_zh: 列出并定义要搜集的所有数据类型，如 PICOS 和资金来源；如适用，描述参考用于制定数据提取表的工具，如 STRICTA 和 TIDieR；对于干预措施信息的提取，针刺干预组和对照组，如假针刺，的详细程度应一致。
items.content_en: List and define all variables for which data were sought, e.g. PICOS and funding sources, and any assumptions and simplifications made; describe data items about details of acupuncture interventions and controls, e.g. sham acupuncture, referring to TIDieR when applicable.

items.domain_en: Risk of bias in individual studies
items.content_zh: 描述用于评价单个研究偏倚风险的方法，包括该方法是用于研究层面还是结局层面，以及在资料合并中该信息如何被利用。
items.content_en: Describe methods used for assessing risk of bias of individual studies, including specification of whether this was done at the study or outcome level, and how this information is to be used in any data synthesis.

items.content_zh: 说明主要的综合结局指标，如相对危险度 risk ratio、均值差 mean difference。
items.content_en: State the principal summary measures, e.g. risk ratio or difference in means.

items.content_zh: 描述结果综合的方法；如果进行了 Meta 分析，则说明异质性检验方法，如 I²。
items.content_en: Describe the methods of handling data and combining results of studies, if done, including measures of consistency, e.g. I², for each meta-analysis.

items.content_zh: 详细评估可能影响数据合并结果的偏倚，如发表偏倚和研究中的选择性报告偏倚。
items.content_en: Specify any assessment of risk of bias that may affect the cumulative evidence, e.g. publication bias and selective reporting within studies.

items.content_zh: 描述其他分析方法，如敏感性分析、亚组分析、Meta回归分析等，并说明哪些分析是预先计划的。
items.content_en: Describe methods of additional analyses, e.g. sensitivity or subgroup analyses, meta-regression, if done, indicating which were pre-specified.

items.content_zh: 报告文献筛选的相应数量，包括每个步骤排除的文献数量和原因，以及最终纳入文献数量；请提供清晰的流程图。
items.content_en: Give numbers of studies screened, assessed for eligibility, and included in the review, with reasons for exclusions at each stage, ideally with a flow diagram.

items.content_zh: 对于每项研究，报告提取的研究特征，如样本量、PICOS、随访时间，并提供纳入研究的引文；参考 TIDieR 模板和 STRICTA 总结针刺干预特征，将每项研究的针刺干预细节总结在表格中。
items.content_en: For each study, present characteristics that were extracted, e.g. study size, PICOS and follow-up period, and provide citations of the included studies. Summarize details of the acupuncture intervention for each study in a table referring to TIDieR.

items.content_zh: 报告所纳入研究对实施针刺后所出现的典型针刺感应，即得气，的描述情况。
items.content_en: Describe details of “De-qi” after acupuncture reported in the included studies.

items.content_zh: 报告每个研究中可能存在的偏倚风险评价结果和相关信息；如果条件允许，还需说明结局层面的评价结果。
items.content_en: Present data on risk of bias of each study and, if available, any outcome-level assessment.

items.content_zh: 针对所有结局指标，包括有效性或安全性，说明每个研究中各干预组的简单合并数据，以及综合效应值及其可信区间；最好以森林图形式报告。
items.content_en: For all outcomes considered, benefits or harms, present for each study: simple summary data for each intervention group and effect estimates with confidence intervals, ideally with a forest plot.

items.content_zh: 报告每个 Meta 分析的结果，包括可信区间和异质性检验结果。
items.content_en: Present results of each meta-analysis done, including confidence intervals and measures of consistency.

items.content_zh: 报告对研究间可能存在的偏倚评价结果，如发表偏倚。
items.content_en: Present results of any assessment of risk of bias across studies.

items.content_zh: 如果做了其他分析，则报告其他分析结果，如敏感性分析、亚组分析和 Meta 回归分析等。
items.content_en: Give results of additional analyses, if done, e.g. sensitivity or subgroup analyses, meta-regression.

items.content_zh: 总结研究的主要发现，包括每个主要结局的证据强度；分析结果与主要利益相关方的关系，如医疗保健提供者和政策制定者。
items.content_en: Summarize the main findings including the strength of evidence for each main outcome; consider their relevance to key groups, e.g. health care providers, users, and policy makers.

items.content_zh: 探讨研究层面和结局层面的局限性，如偏倚风险，以及系统评价层面的局限性，如检索策略不全面、存在报告偏倚等。
items.content_en: Discuss limitations at study and outcome level, e.g. risk of bias, and at review level, e.g. incomplete retrieval of identified research and reporting bias.

items.content_zh: 给出对结果的概要性解析，并提出对未来研究的启示性意义。
items.content_en: Provide a general interpretation of the results in the context of other evidence, and implications for future research.

items.content_zh: 描述系统评价和 Meta 分析制作过程中的资金和其他支持来源，如资料提供，以及资助者在完成系统评价中的作用。
items.content_en: Describe sources of funding for the systematic review and other support, e.g. supply of data, and role of funders for the systematic review.

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 题目中应包含“个案报告”或“病例系列”等词语，并同时说明关注领域。
items.content_en: The words ‘case report’ or ‘case series’ should be in the title along with the area of focus.
items.extension_zh: 题目中应包含“个案报告”一词，并同时说明关注领域。
items.extension_en: The words ‘case report’ should be in the title along with the area of focus

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 关键词 2–5 个，应包括“个案报告”和“针刺”。
items.content_en: Two to five keywords—include ‘case report’ and ‘acupuncture’.
items.extension_zh: 关键词 2–5 个，用于识别本个案报告所涵盖的领域。
items.extension_en: Two to five keywords that identify areas covered in this case report

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 引言：本病例有何独特之处？它为医学文献增加了什么？
items.content_en: Introduction—What is unique about this case? What does it add to the medical literature?
items.extension_zh: 引言：本病例有何独特之处？它为医学文献增加了什么？
items.extension_en: Introduction—What is unique about this case? What does it add to the medical literature?

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 应描述患者的主要症状和重要临床发现；如适用，应同时从常规医学和传统医学角度描述。
items.content_en: The main symptoms of the patient and the important clinical findings should be described both in conventional medicine and traditional medicine, if applicable.
items.extension_zh: 患者的主要症状和重要临床发现。
items.extension_en: The main symptoms of the patient and the important clinical findings

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 明确主要诊断和治疗干预。如适用，应提供常规医学诊断，以及包含传统医学证候的传统医学诊断。干预措施应增加选穴、操作、治疗程序和辅助干预措施。
items.content_en: Define the main diagnoses and therapeutic interventions. Provide both conventional medicine diagnosis and TM diagnosis with TM pattern, if applicable. Interventions add a selection of points, operation, treatment procedures and auxiliary intervention measures.
items.extension_zh: 主要诊断、治疗干预和结局。
items.extension_en: The main diagnoses, therapeutic interventions and outcomes

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 本病例的结论。
items.content_en: Conclusion of this case.
items.extension_zh: 结论：本病例的主要启示是什么？
items.extension_en: Conclusion—What are the main ‘take-away’ lessons from this case?

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 总结病例背景，并结合参考文献说明该病例为何独特或有意义。
items.content_en: Summarising the background of the case and the reason why this case is unique or meaningful with references.
items.extension_zh: 用一至两段文字总结该病例为何独特，并附参考文献。
items.extension_en: One or two paragraphs summarising why this case is unique with references

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 去标识化的人口学信息和其他患者特异性信息。
items.content_en: De-identified demographic information and other patient-specific information.
items.extension_zh: 去标识化的人口学信息和其他患者特异性信息。
items.extension_en: De-identified demographic information and other patient-specific information

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 如适用，应包括患者的主要关注问题和症状，和/或传统医学相关症状，例如盗汗、午后潮热、恶热或恶寒。
items.content_en: Main concerns and symptoms of the patient and/or TM-related symptoms should be included, eg, night sweats, afternoon tidal fever and aversion to heat, or cold, if applicable.
items.extension_zh: 患者的主要关注问题和症状。
items.extension_en: Main concerns and symptoms of the patient

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 如适用，报告医学史、家族史和心理社会史，包括相关遗传信息；另见时间轴。
items.content_en: Medical, family and psychosocial history including relevant genetic information, also see timeline, if applicable.
items.extension_zh: 医学史、家族史和心理社会史，包括相关遗传信息；另见时间轴。
items.extension_en: Medical, family and psychosocial history including relevant genetic information, also see timeline

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 相关既往干预及其结果。
items.content_en: Relevant past interventions and their outcomes.
items.extension_zh: 相关既往干预及其结果。
items.extension_en: Relevant past interventions and their outcomes

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 描述相关体格检查和其他重要临床发现；如适用，尤其应描述传统医学舌脉体征，例如弦脉、红舌、面色淡白等。
items.content_en: Describe the relevant physical examination, PE, and other significant clinical findings, especially TM signs on tongues and pulse, eg, string pulse, red tongue, pale face, if applicable.
items.extension_zh: 描述相关体格检查和其他重要临床发现。
items.extension_en: Describe the relevant PE and other significant clinical findings

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 以时间轴形式组织患者病史。
items.content_en: Patient’s history organised in a timeline.
items.extension_zh: 以时间轴形式组织患者病史中的重要信息。
items.extension_en: Important information from the patient’s history organised as a timeline

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 诊断方法应描述为常规医学方法和/或传统医学辨证方法，例如八纲辨证、脏腑辨证和六经辨证。
items.content_en: Diagnostic methods shall be described both/either in conventional medicine method and/or TM syndrome differentiation, eg, eight principles differentiation, Zang-fu organs differentiation and six meridians differentiation.
items.extension_zh: 诊断方法，例如体格检查、实验室检查、影像学检查、调查量表等。
items.extension_en: Diagnostic methods, such as PE, laboratory testing, imaging, surveys

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 描述诊断推理过程，包括基于相关症状和体征进行常规医学分析和/或传统医学辨证分析的过程。
items.content_en: Diagnostic reasoning including the analysis process of conventional medicine and/or TM differentiation based on its relevant symptoms and signs.
items.extension_zh: 诊断挑战，例如可及性、经济或文化因素。
items.extension_en: Diagnostic challenges, such as access, financial or cultural

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 如适用，报告预后特征，例如肿瘤分期。
items.content_en: Prognostic characteristics, such as staging in oncology, where applicable.
items.extension_zh: 诊断推理，包括考虑过的其他诊断。
items.extension_en: Diagnostic reasoning including other diagnoses considered

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 针刺治疗风格/原则，例如中医针刺、韩医针刺、日本针刺、西医针刺；针刺类型，例如电针、火针、耳针或头针；以及针刺联合治疗或其他干预，例如艾灸、中药、生活方式建议、西医治疗。
items.content_en: Style/principle of acupuncture treatment, eg, Traditional Chinese Medicine, Korean Medicine, Japanese Medicine, Western medical acupuncture; type of acupuncture, eg, electroacupuncture, fire acupuncture, ear acupuncture or scalp acupuncture; and combined therapy of acupuncture or other interventions, eg, moxibustion, herbs, lifestyle advice, Western medicine.
items.extension_zh: 干预类型，例如药物、手术、预防性干预或自我照护。
items.extension_en: Types of intervention, such as pharmacological, surgical, preventive, self-care

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 针刺处方，例如针具类型、选穴、操作、进针深度和角度、针感传导方向、操作手法，包括提插和捻转技术、手法强度、预期反应、留针时间、治疗程序和辅助干预措施。
items.content_en: Acupuncture prescription, eg, type of needle, selection of points, operation, depth and angle of insertion, direction of twitch, the manipulation method involving thrusting, lifting and rotating techniques, intensity of these manipulation methods, response sought, needle retention time, treatment procedures and auxiliary intervention measures.
items.extension_zh: 干预实施方式，例如剂量、强度、持续时间。
items.extension_en: Administration of intervention, such as dosage, strength, duration

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 治疗过程中如有针刺处方变化，例如穴位、手法、针具类型改变，应清楚说明；如适用，应结合其传统医学理论依据。
items.content_en: Any changes in acupuncture prescription, eg, acupuncture points, manipulation, needle types, during the treatment should be clearly explained, with its TM theory if applicable.
items.extension_zh: 干预变化及其理由。
items.extension_en: Changes in intervention, with rationale

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 针刺操作者背景，例如资质、培训时长、工作地点、执业经历、教育背景和其他相关经验。
items.content_en: Practitioner background regarding acupuncture, eg, qualification-training hours, work place, practice history, education background, other relevant experience.

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 临床医生和患者评价的结局，如适用。
items.content_en: Clinician and patient-assessed outcomes, when appropriate.
items.extension_zh: 临床医生和患者评价的结局，如适用。
items.extension_en: Clinician and patient-assessed outcomes, when appropriate

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 描述重要的随访诊断和针刺治疗情况；如适用，尤其应描述传统医学辨证变化和其他检查结果变化。
items.content_en: Describe important follow-up diagnostic and acupuncture treatment, especially the changes of TM syndrome differentiation and other test results if applicable.
items.extension_zh: 重要的随访诊断和其他检查结果。
items.extension_en: Important follow-up diagnostic and other test results

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 干预依从性和耐受性。如何评价？
items.content_en: Intervention adherence and tolerability. How was this assessed?
items.extension_zh: 干预依从性和耐受性。如何评价？
items.extension_en: Intervention adherence and tolerability. How was this assessed?

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 不良事件和非预期事件。如适用，应报告针刺特异性不良事件，例如晕针、断针、滞针。
items.content_en: Adverse and unanticipated events. Specific adverse events of acupuncture, eg, fainting during acupuncture treatment, needle breakage, stuck needle should be reported if applicable.
items.extension_zh: 不良事件和非预期事件。
items.extension_en: Adverse and unanticipated events

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 讨论本病例处理方法的优势和局限性。如适用，描述针刺与常规治疗相比的潜在优势和劣势。
items.content_en: Discussion of the strengths and limitations in your approach to this case. Description of the potential advantages and disadvantages of acupuncture compared with conventional treatment, if applicable.
items.extension_zh: 讨论本病例处理方法的优势和局限性。
items.extension_en: Discussion of the strengths and limitations in your approach to this case

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 讨论相关医学文献。
items.content_en: Discussion of the relevant medical literature.
items.extension_zh: 讨论相关医学文献。
items.extension_en: Discussion of the relevant medical literature

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 说明得出结论的依据，包括对可能原因的评估。对于独特病例，应谨慎作出一般性结论。
items.content_en: The rationale for conclusions, including assessment of possible causes. Please be cautious in drawing general conclusions in unique cases.
items.extension_zh: 得出结论的依据，包括对可能原因的评估。
items.extension_en: The rationale for conclusions, including assessment of possible causes

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 本个案报告的主要启示。
items.content_en: The primary ‘take-away’ lessons of this case report.
items.extension_zh: 本个案报告的主要启示。
items.extension_en: The primary ‘take-away’ lessons of this case report

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 应强调针刺相关回顾性调查，例如疗效、可及性、优势、费用和个体化治疗体验。
items.content_en: The retrospective survey of acupuncture, eg, therapeutic efficacy, accessibility, advantages, cost and individualised treatment experience, should be emphasised.
items.extension_zh: 如适当，患者应分享其对所接受治疗的看法。
items.extension_en: When appropriate, the patient should share their perspective on the treatments they received

items.ext_label_zh: CARE 原条目
items.content_zh: 如有要求，请提供伦理审批和知情同意。
items.content_en: Please provide ethics and informed consent if requested.
items.extension_zh: 患者是否给予知情同意？如有要求，请提供。
items.extension_en: Did the patient give informed consent? Please provide if requested

items.content_zh: 在题目中明确本报告为“指南”或“推荐意见”，并同时包含“针灸”相关表述。
items.content_en: Identify the report as a guideline in the title, with “guideline(s)” or “recommendation(s)”, together with the term “acupuncture”.

items.content_zh: 提供指南的发表年份。
items.content_en: Provide the year of publication of the guideline.

items.content_zh: 描述指南关注的重点，例如治疗、预防、管理或其他内容。
items.content_en: Describe the focus of the guideline, such as treatment, prevention, management, or others.

items.content_zh: 提供指南所含推荐意见的摘要。
items.content_en: Provide a summary of the recommendations contained in the guideline.

items.domain_zh: 基本信息：缩略语和首字母缩略词
items.content_zh: 定义新的和关键术语；提供缩略语和首字母缩略词列表，以及采用国际标准的穴位代码，该国际标准应由 WHO、WFAS 或 WFCMS 等权威机构制定；如适用，应清楚解释新的概念。
items.content_en: Define new and key terms; provide a list of abbreviations and acronyms as well as acupoint codes using an international standard defined by an authority such as WHO, WFAS or WFCMS; and, if applicable, explain the new concepts clearly.

items.content_zh: 至少确定1名可联系的通讯制定者或作者，以便回答与指南相关的问题。至少1名通讯制定者应为针灸临床专家。
items.content_en: Identify at least one corresponding developer or author who can be contacted for questions related to the guideline. At least one of the corresponding developers should be an acupuncture clinical specialist.

items.domain_zh: 背景：健康问题简要描述
items.domain_en: Background: Brief description of the health problem(s)
items.content_zh: 描述健康问题的基本流行病学信息，例如患病率/发病率、患病情况、死亡率，以及该问题造成的负担，包括经济负担。
items.content_en: Describe the basic epidemiology of the problem, such as the prevalence/incidence, morbidity, mortality, and burden, including financial burden, resulting from the problem.

items.content_zh: 总结经典文献中对所考虑疾病的诊断和治疗。
items.content_en: Summarize the diagnosis and treatment of the diseases under consideration in classic texts.

items.content_zh: 描述专家共识现状，包括传统医学医师的经验，以及针灸治疗的技术规范和既往推荐意见。
items.content_en: Describe the status of expert consensus including the experience among traditional medicine physicians, as well as technical specifications and previous recommendations for acupuncture treatment.

items.content_zh: 描述常规治疗的局限性，以及针灸的潜在优势和补充作用。
items.content_en: Describe the limitations of conventional treatment and the potential advantages of acupuncture and its complementary role.

items.domain_zh: 背景：指南目的和具体目标
items.domain_en: Background: Aim(s) of the guideline and specific objectives
items.content_zh: 描述指南的目的和具体目标，例如改善健康指标，如死亡率和疾病患病率、生活质量，或节约成本。
items.content_en: Describe the aim(s) of the guideline and specific objectives, such as improvements in health indicators, for example mortality and disease prevalence, quality of life, or cost savings.

items.content_zh: 说明针灸指南的目标对象属于：西医定义疾病、传统医学证候，或西医定义疾病合并特定传统医学证候。传统医学证候应根据 WHO ICD-11 传统医学章节进行定义。
items.content_en: State the targets of the acupuncture guideline(s) in terms of a Western medicine-defined disease, a traditional medicine pattern, or a Western medicine-defined disease with a specific traditional medicine pattern. The traditional medicine pattern should be defined in terms of the WHO ICD-11 traditional medicine chapter.

items.content_zh: 描述指南中特别考虑的任何亚组，例如特定传统医学证候和疾病分期。
items.content_en: Describe any subgroups that are given special consideration in the guideline, for example a specific traditional medicine pattern and stage of disease.

items.domain_zh: 背景：最终使用者和适用场景
items.content_zh: 描述指南预期的主要使用者，例如个体从业者、公共卫生从业者、卫生政策决策者和支付方，以及指南的其他潜在使用者。
items.content_en: Describe the intended primary users of the guideline, for example individual practitioners, public health practitioners, health policy decision makers and payers, and other potential users of the guideline.

items.domain_zh: 背景：最终使用者和适用场景
items.content_zh: 描述针灸指南预期适用的场景，例如实施针灸治疗所需的资质条件和卫生条件。
items.content_en: Describe the setting(s) for which the acupuncture guideline is intended, such as qualifications and sanitary conditions which are required for the acupuncture treatment.

items.content_zh: 描述“专家组构建”，即所有指南制定参与者如何被遴选，以及其角色和职责，例如指导小组、指南专家组、外部评审者、系统综述团队和方法学专家。
items.content_en: Describe “Construction of Panel”, how all contributors to the guideline development were selected and their roles and responsibilities, for example steering group, guideline panel, external reviewers, systematic review team and methodologists.

items.content_zh: 列出所有参与指南制定的人员，包括其职称、角色、所在机构、地理位置以及与针灸相关的信息。
items.content_en: List all individuals involved in developing the guideline, including their title, role(s), institutional affiliation(s), geographical location and acupuncture related information.

items.content_zh: 目标对象： 西医定义疾病、传统医学证候，或西医定义疾病合并特定传统医学证候。
items.content_en: Target: a Western medicine-defined disease, a traditional medicine pattern, or a Western medicine-defined disease with a specific traditional medicine pattern.

items.content_zh: 干预措施： 1）针灸类型，例如手针、电针、火针、耳针或头针等；2）针灸治疗细节，例如选穴、操作、治疗程序和辅助干预措施；3）操作者背景，例如资质或专业隶属、针灸实践年限和其他相关经验。
items.content_en: Interventions: 1) style of acupuncture, for example manual acupuncture, electroacupuncture, fire acupuncture, ear acupuncture, or scalp acupuncture; 2) details of the acupuncture treatment, for example selection of points, operation, treatment procedures and auxiliary intervention measures; 3) practitioner background, for example qualification or professional affiliation, years in acupuncture practice and other relevant experience.

items.content_zh: 对照或比较干预，如适用： 1）说明在研究问题背景下选择对照或比较干预的理由；2）准确描述对照或比较干预。如果使用假针刺或其他类似针刺的对照，请提供下文 14a.2 中提到的细节。
items.content_en: Control or comparator interventions, if applicable: 1) indicate the rationale for the control or comparator in the context of the research question; 2) describe precisely the control or comparator. If sham acupuncture or any other type of acupuncture-like controls are used, provide details mentioned in 14a.2.

items.content_zh: 结局： 与传统医学证候类型和安全性评价相关的结局指标。
items.content_en: Outcomes: outcome indicators related to traditional medicine syndrome type and safety evaluation.

items.content_zh: 说明结局指标是如何选择的。
items.content_en: Indicate how the outcomes were selected.

items.content_zh: 说明指南是否基于为本指南专门开展的新系统综述或系统综述概述，或者是否使用了已有系统综述。
items.content_en: Indicate whether the guideline is based on new systematic reviews or overviews of systematic reviews that were specifically conducted for the purpose of this guideline, or whether existing systematic reviews were used.

items.content_zh: 如果指南制定者使用了已有系统综述或系统综述概述，应引用这些综述，并描述这些综述如何被识别和评价，包括检索策略、选择标准、系统综述质量评价过程，以及证据的新近程度。
items.content_en: If the guideline developers used existing systematic reviews or overviews of systematic reviews, reference these and describe how those reviews were identified and assessed, including search strategies, selection criteria, quality evaluation process, and how recent the evidence is.

items.domain_zh: 证据：证据体确定性评价
items.domain_en: Evidence: Assessment of the certainty of the body of evidence
items.content_zh: 描述用于评价证据体确定性的方法。
items.content_en: Describe the approach used to assess the certainty of the body of evidence.

items.content_zh: 提供清晰、准确、可操作的推荐意见。描述从 11a.1 和 11a.2 总结出的推荐干预及其目标对象。
items.content_en: Provide clear, precise and actionable recommendations. Describe the recommended intervention and its target summarized from 11a.1 and 11a.2.

items.content_zh: 如果证据提示不同亚组在影响推荐意见的因素方面存在重要差异，尤其是在获益和危害平衡方面存在差异，应针对不同亚组提出具体推荐意见。
items.content_en: Present specific recommendations for different subgroups if the evidence suggests that there are important differences in factors influencing the recommendations, particularly in the balance of benefits and harms across subgroups.

items.content_zh: 说明推荐强度和支持证据的确定性。
items.content_en: Indicate the strength of recommendations and the certainty of the supporting evidence.

items.domain_zh: 推荐意见：推荐理由/解释
items.content_zh: 描述在形成每条推荐意见时，是否陈述了目标人群的基础价值观和偏好。如是，应描述用于获取或识别这些价值观和偏好的方法。
items.content_en: Describe whether the underlined values and preferences of the target population(s) were stated in the formulation of each recommendation. If yes, describe the approaches and methods used to elicit or identify these values and preferences.

items.domain_zh: 推荐意见：推荐理由/解释
items.content_zh: 描述在形成推荐意见时，是否考虑了成本和资源影响。如是，应描述所用具体方法，例如成本-效果分析，并总结结果。如未考虑资源问题，应提供解释。
items.content_en: Describe whether cost and resource implications were considered in the formulation of the recommendations. If yes, describe the specific approaches and methods used, such as cost-effectiveness analysis, and summarize the results. If resource issues were not considered, provide an explanation.

items.domain_zh: 推荐意见：推荐理由/解释
items.content_zh: 描述形成推荐意见时考虑的其他因素，例如公平性、可行性和可接受性。
items.content_en: Describe other factors taken into consideration when formulating the recommendations, such as equity, feasibility and acceptability.

items.domain_zh: 推荐意见：推荐理由/解释
items.content_zh: 描述经典古籍、传统医学医师经验和技术规范是否以及如何影响推荐意见。
items.content_en: Describe whether, and how, classical books, traditional medicine physicians’ experience and technical specifications influenced the recommendations.

items.domain_zh: 推荐意见：从证据到决策过程
items.content_zh: 描述指南制定小组作出决策所用的过程和方法，特别是推荐意见的形成过程，例如如何定义并达成共识，以及是否使用投票。
items.content_en: Describe the processes and approaches used by the guideline development group to make decisions, particularly the formulation of recommendations, such as how consensus was defined and achieved and whether voting was used.

items.domain_zh: 评审和质量保证：外部评审
items.domain_en: Review and Quality Assurance: External review
items.content_zh: 说明指南草案是否经过独立评审；如是，应说明评审如何实施，以及如何考虑和处理评审意见。如适用，应列出外部评审专家组，例如资深针灸专家、临床一线针灸师和方法学专家。
items.content_en: Indicate whether the draft guideline underwent independent review and, if so, how the review was executed and the comments considered and addressed. The external review panel, for example senior acupuncture specialists, clinical first-line acupuncturists and methodologists, should be listed if applicable.

items.domain_zh: 评审和质量保证：质量保证
items.domain_en: Review and Quality Assurance: Quality assurance
items.content_zh: 说明指南是否经过质量保证过程。如是，应描述该过程。如适用，应向相关卫生机构、针灸专业学会或相关组织提交意见函以供批准。
items.content_en: Indicate whether the guideline was subject to a quality assurance process. If yes, describe the process. Submit a letter of opinion to the relevant health institution, the acupuncture professional society or the relevant organization, if applicable, for approval.

items.domain_zh: 资助及利益声明和管理：资助来源及资助方作用
items.domain_en: Funding and Declaration and Management of Interests: Funding source(s) and role(s) of the funder
items.content_zh: 描述指南制定所有阶段的具体资助来源。
items.content_en: Describe the specific sources of funding for all stages of guideline development.

items.domain_zh: 资助及利益声明和管理：资助来源及资助方作用
items.domain_en: Funding and Declaration and Management of Interests: Funding source(s) and role(s) of the funder
items.content_zh: 描述资助方在指南制定不同阶段以及推荐意见传播和实施中的作用。
items.content_en: Describe the role of funder(s) in the different stages of guideline development and in the dissemination and implementation of the recommendations.

items.domain_zh: 资助及利益声明和管理：利益冲突声明和管理
items.domain_en: Funding and Declaration and Management of Interests: Declaration and management of conflict interest
items.content_zh: 描述与指南制定相关的利益冲突，包括经济性和非经济性利益冲突。
items.content_en: Describe the conflicts of interest, financial and non-financial, that were relevant to guideline development.

items.domain_zh: 资助及利益声明和管理：利益冲突声明和管理
items.domain_en: Funding and Declaration and Management of Interests: Declaration and management of conflict interest
items.content_zh: 描述利益冲突如何被评价和管理，以及指南使用者如何获取利益声明。
items.content_en: Describe how conflicts of interest were evaluated and managed and how users of the guideline can access the declarations.

items.content_zh: 描述指南、附录和其他相关文件可从何处获取。
items.content_en: Describe where the guideline, its appendices, and other related documents can be accessed.

items.domain_zh: 其他信息：未来研究建议
items.domain_en: Other Information: Suggestions for further research
items.content_zh: 描述证据空白，和/或提出未来研究建议。
items.content_en: Describe the gaps in the evidence and/or provide suggestions for future research.

items.domain_en: Other Information: Limitations of the guideline
items.content_zh: 描述指南制定过程中的任何局限性，例如制定小组并非多学科组成，或未获取患者价值观和偏好；并说明这些局限性可能如何影响推荐意见的有效性。
items.content_en: Describe any limitations in the guideline development process, such as the development groups were not multidisciplinary or patients’ values and preferences were not sought, and indicate how these limitations might have affected the validity of the recommendations.

items.content_zh: 对于每个实验，给出简要的研究设计细节，包括：a. 比较的组别，包括对照组；如果没有对照组，应阐明理由。b. 实验单元，如单只动物、一窝动物或一笼动物。
items.content_en: For each experiment, provide brief details of study design including: a. The groups being compared, including control groups. If no control group has been used, the rationale should be stated. b. The experimental unit, e.g. a single animal, litter, or cage of animals.

items.content_zh: a. 详细说明分配给每个实验组的确切实验单元，以及每次实验的动物总数、整个实验使用的动物总数。b. 解释样本量如何决定；如进行了样本量计算，应提供预先计算细节。
items.content_en: a. Specify the exact number of experimental units allocated to each group, and the total number in each experiment. Also indicate the total number of animals used. b. Explain how the sample size was decided. Provide details of any a priori sample size calculation, if done.

items.content_zh: a. 描述实验期间用于纳入和排除动物、实验单元或数据点的标准，并说明是否预先设立。b. 报告每组分析中被排除的动物、实验单元或数据点及原因；如无排除，也应说明。c. 对于每次分析，报告每组实验单元的准确数量。
items.content_en: a. Describe any criteria used for including and excluding animals or experimental units during the experiment, and data points during the analysis. Specify if these criteria were established a priori. If no criteria were set, state this explicitly. b. For each experimental group, report any animals, experimental units or data points not included in the analysis and explain why. If there were no exclusions, state so. c. For each analysis, report the exact value of n in each experimental group.

items.content_zh: a. 说明是否采用随机化方法将实验单元分配至对照组和处理组；如采用随机化，应提供随机序列生成方法。b. 描述用于减少潜在混杂因素的策略，如处理和测量顺序、动物或笼子位置；如未控制混杂因素，应明确说明。
items.content_en: a. State whether randomisation was used to allocate experimental units to control and treatment groups. If done, provide the method used to generate the randomisation sequence. b. Describe the strategy used to minimise potential confounders such as the order of treatments and measurements, or animal/cage location. If confounders were not controlled, state this explicitly.

items.content_zh: 描述实验不同阶段谁知晓分组情况，包括分配、实验实施、结局评价和数据分析。
items.content_en: Describe who was aware of the group allocation at the different stages of the experiment, including allocation, conduct of the experiment, outcome assessment, and data analysis.

items.content_zh: a. 清晰定义所有结局评价指标，如细胞死亡、分子标记或行为改变。b. 对于假说检验性研究，应明确主要结局指标，例如用于样本量计算的结局指标。
items.content_en: a. Clearly define all outcome measures assessed, e.g. cell death, molecular markers, or behavioural changes. b. For hypothesis-testing studies, specify the primary outcome measure, i.e. the outcome measure used to determine the sample size.

items.content_zh: a. 提供每次分析所用统计方法的细节，包括统计软件。b. 描述如何评估数据是否满足统计假设，以及当统计假设不满足时所做的方法变更。
items.content_en: a. Provide details of the statistical methods used for each analysis, including software used. b. Describe any methods used to assess whether the data met the assumptions of the statistical approach, and what was done if the assumptions were not met.

items.content_zh: a. 提供动物种类的详细资料，包括物种、品系、亚系、雌雄、年龄或发育阶段，以及相关时的体重。b. 提供动物来源、健康/免疫状态、基因修饰状态、基因型和既往实验使用情况等。
items.content_en: a. Provide species-appropriate details of the animals used, including species, strain and substrain, sex, age or developmental stage, and, if relevant, weight. b. Provide further relevant information on the provenance of animals, health/immune status, genetic modification status, genotype, and any previous procedures.

items.content_zh: 对每个实验组，包括对照组，描述足以让其他研究者重复实验的细节，包括：a. 内容、方法和材料。b. 时间和频次。c. 地点，包括适应期细节。d. 进行这些程序的理由。
items.content_en: For each experimental group, including controls, describe the procedures in enough detail to allow others to replicate them, including: a. What was done, how it was done and what was used. b. When and how often. c. Where, including details of any acclimatisation periods. d. Why, providing rationale for procedures.

items.content_zh: 对每次实验，包括独立重复实验，报告：a. 每组的总结性或描述性统计结果，并在适用时报告变异度，如均值和标准差、中位数和范围。b. 适用时报告效应量及其可信区间。
items.content_en: For each experiment conducted, including independent replications, report: a. Summary/descriptive statistics for each experimental group, with a measure of variability where applicable, e.g. mean and SD, or median and range. b. If applicable, the effect size with a confidence interval.

items.content_zh: 提供准确摘要，包括研究目标、动物物种、品系和雌雄、关键方法、主要结果和研究结论。
items.content_en: Provide an accurate summary of the research objectives, animal species, strain and sex, key methods, principal findings, and study conclusions.

items.content_zh: a. 包括足够科学背景，有助于理解研究理由和背景，并解释实验方案。b. 解释实验中使用的动物种类和模型如何达到研究目标；适用时，说明与人类生物学的相关性。
items.content_en: a. Include sufficient scientific background to understand the rationale and context for the study, and explain the experimental approach. b. Explain how the animal species and model used address the scientific objectives and, where appropriate, the relevance to human biology.

items.content_zh: 清楚描述研究问题、研究目标；适用时，说明研究的具体假说。
items.content_en: Clearly describe the research question, research objectives and, where appropriate, specific hypotheses being tested.

items.content_zh: 提供批准本次动物实验的伦理审查委员会或相应机构名称，以及相关许可证或方案编号。如未申请或未获得伦理批准，应说明原因。
items.content_en: Provide the name of the ethical review committee or equivalent that has approved the use of animals in this study, and any relevant licence or protocol numbers, if applicable. If ethical approval was not sought or granted, provide a justification.

items.content_zh: 提供饲养场所和饲养条件的细节，包括环境改善措施。
items.content_en: Provide details of housing and husbandry conditions, including any environmental enrichment.

items.content_zh: a. 描述实验方案中为减轻动物疼痛、折磨和苦痛所采取的干预措施或步骤。b. 报告任何预期或非预期不良事件。c. 描述人道终点、监测指标和监测频率；如未采用人道终点，应说明。
items.content_en: a. Describe any interventions or steps taken in the experimental protocols to reduce pain, suffering and distress. b. Report any expected or unexpected adverse events. c. Describe the humane endpoints established for the study, the signs that were monitored and the frequency of monitoring. If the study did not have humane endpoints, state this.

items.content_zh: a. 结合研究目标和假说、当前理论及相关文献解释结果。b. 评价研究局限性，包括潜在偏倚来源、动物模型局限性和结果不精确性。
items.content_en: a. Interpret the results, taking into account the study objectives and hypotheses, current theory and other relevant studies in the literature. b. Comment on the study limitations including potential sources of bias, limitations of the animal model, and imprecision associated with the results.

items.content_zh: 讨论研究结果是否以及如何可能适用于其他物种或实验条件；适用时，说明与人类生物学的关联。
items.content_en: Comment on whether, and how, the findings of this study are likely to generalise to other species or experimental conditions, including any relevance to human biology, where appropriate.

items.content_zh: 声明研究前是否准备了实验方案，包括研究问题、关键设计特点和分析计划；说明该实验方案是否注册，以及在哪里注册。
items.content_en: Provide a statement indicating whether a protocol, including the research question, key design features, and analysis plan, was prepared before the study, and if and where this protocol was registered.

items.content_zh: 声明研究数据是否可以获取，以及可以从何处或通过何种方式获得。
items.content_en: Provide a statement describing if and where study data are available.

items.content_zh: a. 声明任何潜在利益冲突，包括经济和非经济利益冲突；如无利益冲突，也应声明。b. 列出所有资助来源，包括课题编号，并说明资助方在研究设计、分析和报告中的作用。
items.content_en: a. Declare any potential conflicts of interest, including financial and non-financial. If none exist, this should be stated. b. List all funding sources, including grant identifier, and the role of the funder(s) in the design, analysis and reporting of the study.
